name: Pokémon Ranger Star
summary: On this game you will embark on an adventure as a Pokémon Ranger, rescuing Pokémon, helping people, protecting the environment, exploring the world and solving mysteries! This game plays a little different when compared to the traditional Pokémon games. Here, each battle is in real time! You can command your Pokémon and your trainer to unleash powerful moves and dodge your enemy attacks! The game offers a beautiful region with amazing vistas, and biomes filled with unique Pokémon and secrets to find.
